raised: The page never says which track is mine, and the fee shown is a 2025 average, not necessarily what I pay
The 60+ track rows are cut off between screens, so some numbers are missing (the comprehensive fund's figures and the provident fund's 5-year return)
The budgetary pension fund charges 1.33%, far more than anything else, and the page doesn't say why
The '123 מקורו / 123 מחושב' line is confusing
The track counts don't match: 105 vs '96 tracks in 7 products', with 9 buttons; this lowers trust
Doesn't understand 'קמ"פ'
The footer date (03.11.2026) differs from the 'end of September' date at the top
Two fee figures (from savings vs from deposits): unclear whether both are paid and which one hurts more
Returns are shown before fees, so the real gain is lower
Many tracks show 'less than 3 years', with no return at all
The PF-06 and PF-10 codes mean nothing
'מניות 99% / מט"ח 99%' don't add up as expected
Direct expenses are charged on top of the fees but not shown, so the true cost is unknown
Track names such as 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש', 'קיימות' and 'כספי (שקלי)' are not understood
The index-fund fee terms (fixed / variable / trustee) are not understood
No yearly cost and result in shekels
No last-year result and no sign of whether a track ever lost money
No comparison with other companies
No information on what happens if I move, or the cost of moving
No plain-language risk level for each track
Would remove the index-fund and ETF sections with their badges
Would remove the 'חיסכון לכל ילד' section
Would remove the 'לא מצאתם שם?' search box
Would remove the rings
Would remove the 'מרכזית לפיצויים' section

problems.why: The reader is confused by the fee column's two parts (from savings vs from deposits) and asks whether both are paid, which is a clear part of the column not being explained.
